display_long_description:
Theraply VR is an innovative platform and software - facilitating your work with your child through specially designed educational and therapeutic mini games.‍

The solution we offer is to use virtual reality in play so as to support children with special educational needs as much as possible.... but there is more!

Virtual reality (VR) technology opens up completely new possibilities in both education and therapy (psychological, pedagogical, revalidation).

Children love the activities in Theraply VR, parents fully appreciate it and directors receive congratulations for the great work of the facility. 😊

The app, available in this shop, serves the pupil who simply has fun in the goggles and the Therapist or Teacher can control the VR app, view what is happening in the goggles and manage the pupils and their progress in education and development through a dedicated mobile app available on selected Android and iOS.
